events.title: Veterans Day: Sponsor a Veteran Flag
events.description: Join Oak Farm Vineyards in honoring the brave men and women who have served our country by sponsoring an American flag in their name for $75. Every sponsored flag will be proudly displayed in front of the winery as a visible tribute, and every dollar raised goes directly to VeteranHelp.net, a local San Joaquin County organization dedicated to helping veterans. Sponsor a flag in honor of a veteran, a loved one who has served, or someone currently serving in the military.  Sponsor a Flag  Download the flyer (PDF)

events.title: Winter Club Release Open House with music by Clerical Estate
events.description: Join us for our Winter Club Release Open House! It's a two-day event, Saturday and Sunday, November 14 & 15. Pick up your club wines and stay a while. Food will be available for purchase starting at 9am, club tastings and pickups begin at 12pm, and Clerical Estate will be playing from 12pm to 4pm. It's open house style, so there's no cost to club members. Please RSVP here by November 12. Your RSVP simply helps us plan staffing and know how many friends to expect. It doesn't reserve a table or seating, and seating is first come, first served. Learn more about the band on Clerical Estate's Facebook page.
